'''The Motion Pictures''' is the 29th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 17 April 2002. The set consists of 134 cards.

Star Trek CCG heads to the movies with a brand-new expansion set featuring cards from all nine movies, from '''Star Trek: The Motion Picture''' to '''Star Trek Insurrection'''. Villains from Khan to Chang to Ru'afo, perils from V'Ger to Genesis to the Nexus... Starfleet's finest are out saving the galaxy from them all. Whether saving the whales or searching for Sha Ka Ree is your idea of a good time, you'll find it in Star Trek CCG: The Motion Pictures. Even the Voyager-only format is supported, with cards from the Voyager episode "Flashback" tying in to Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country.

This set is available in 11-card booster packs and there are 36 booster packs in 1 booster box. Each pack contains 1 rare card and a mix of 6 common and 4 uncommon cards.

[[Decipher]] did not issue a Rules Supplement/Card List sheet for this expansion.

This set is noted for the following:
*Introduced the '''The Motion Pictures, The Wrath of Khan, The Search for Spock, The Voyage Hone, The Final Frontier, The Undiscovered Country, Generations, and Insurrection''' property logos
*Included the release of Ensign Tuvok, making it the last card to be officially released as a black border card from the white border promo cards from [[First Anthology (Star Trek CCG 1E)|First Anthology]] expansion
*Included the Ultra-Rare James T. Kirk found in 1:121 packs and another range of Rare+ cards (33% more rare than the normal Rare}
*Marks the last set to include an official errata from Decipher (Ensign Tuvok)


[[The Continuing Committee]] released [[The Motion Pictures Remastered (expansion)|The Motion Pictures Remastered]] virtual expansion set on 24 June 2022 giving the original expansion set new life with updated names, game text, and icons. Eighty-two of the original cards received errata at the same time to match the updates made in [[The Motion Pictures Remastered (expansion)|The Motion Pictures Remastered]] virtual expansion set.
